paper_title: A New Bound on Axion-Like Particles
notes: ALP-photon conversion bound from Chandra X-ray observations of M87 in Virgo cluster. Benchmark 95% CL limit g_agamma < 1.49e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a < 3e-12 eV (B0=31.5uG). Abstract quotes conservative bound 2.6e-12 (B0=35uG); stronger bounds 1.1-1.5e-12 for other field models. Encoded flat benchmark limit valid for m_a<3e-12 eV as horizontal line.
